question: Within what distance and with what attitude may a displaced liṅga be installed?
premises: A displaced liṅga may need reinstallation.
A maximum distance of up to a thousand bow-lengths is specified.
The installation must be performed with respect.
inference: Therefore, one may install the liṅga up to a thousand bow-lengths away, doing so with respect.
plain_english: One should install the liṅga, even up to a thousand bow-lengths away, with respect.
